name: Enter a GitHub release
description: Recording a release as a testing version. Two statements, not one: db_write returns only rows_affected, so the row is read back, and both statements join live_sessions -- a revoked session must neither write nor read, and the read-back alone deciding 201 would fail open. The insert carries the open season's rules as PREDICATES, so a refusal is a row that was never written rather than a check that could be raced; zero rows then sends `why` to read the state back and `refused` answers 409 with one word. The duplicate refusal deliberately does not name the version it collided with: unique_weights excludes the caller, so the row it matched is always another competitor's, and naming or dating it would report one competitor's submission to another.

tasks.name: Both hashes, declared and well formed
tasks.description: `sha256:` and 71 characters, which is the shape and not the alphabet -- datalogic has no regex operator. The alphabet is checked where it matters: axon derives the object-store key from the hash and refuses anything that is not 64 hex digits, which is what stops a hash from being a path.

logic.detail: weights_hash and adapter_hash are required, each as sha256:<64 hex>. Run `sha256sum model.onnx adapter.json` on the files you attached to the release.

input.query: INSERT INTO models (owner_id, game_id, season_id, version, repo, release_tag, weights_hash, adapter_hash) SELECT ($1)::uuid, g.id, s.id, coalesce(max(m.version), 0) + 1, ($3)::text, ($4)::text, ($6)::text, ($7)::text FROM games g JOIN seasons s ON s.game_id = g.id AND s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.submissions_open_at <= now() AND now() < s.submissions_close_at JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.sid = ($5)::uuid AND ls.user_id = ($1)::uuid LEFT JOIN models m ON m.owner_id = ($1)::uuid AND m.game_id = g.id WHERE g.slug = ($2)::text AND season_admits(s, ($1)::uuid) AND season_admits_weights(s, ($1)::uuid, ($6)::text) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM models f WHERE f.owner_id = ($1)::uuid AND f.game_id = g.id AND f.status IN ('testing', 'verified')) GROUP BY g.id, s.id

SELECT json_build_object( 'season', s.number, 'state', CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN season_state(s) END, 'submissions_open_at', s.submissions_open_at, 'submissions_close_at', s.submissions_close_at, 'participant', s.id IS NULL OR season_admits(s, ($2)::uuid), 'in_flight', (SELECT json_build_object('model_id', f.id, 'version', f.version) FROM models f WHERE f.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND f.game_id = g.id AND f.status IN ('testing', 'verified')), 'unique_weights_scope', coalesce(s.rules -> 'unique_weights' ->> 'scope', 'game'), 'unique_weights', s.id IS NULL OR season_admits_weights(s, ($2)::uuid, ($3)::text)) AS body FROM games g LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.game_id = g.id AND s.closed_at IS NULL WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text

tasks.name: Refused by the season
tasks.description: A revoked session also inserts nothing and is not this task's: with the season open and both rules satisfied it falls through to the read-back, whose empty result `deny` answers 401.

input.query: SELECT json_build_object('model_id', m.id, 'version', m.version, 'status', m.status, 'season', se.number, 'weights_hash', m.weights_hash, 'adapter_hash', m.adapter_hash) AS body FROM models m JOIN games g ON g.id = m.game_id JOIN seasons se ON se.id = m.season_id AND se.closed_at IS NULL JOIN live_sessions s ON s.sid = ($5)::uuid AND s.user_id = m.owner_id WHERE m.owner_id = ($1)::uuid AND g.slug = ($2)::text AND m.repo = ($3)::text AND m.release_tag = ($4)::text
